text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Seeking the Pearl hadn't shown up
even though it was time for training,
so while looking around for her...

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
If you win races all over the world,
you get to do winner interviews in each country, right?

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
"That's why I'm studying languages!
Right now it's French. The next one I'll learn is—"
choice_data_list: ...First, if you want to win, you have to train.

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
? Why, of course it is!
Training is the very first step toward taking on the world—

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
Oh goodness...!!
Did I completely forget about training...?!

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry, Trainer...!
I'm so pathetic...
I swear I will never do this again...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She seemed truly remorseful,
so I decided to let the matter drop.
